matches_toss_valid.name: matches_toss_valid
matches_toss_valid.value: ("matches"."toss_winner_team_id" is null and "matches"."toss_decision" is null) or ("matches"."toss_winner_team_id" in ("matches"."team_a_id", "matches"."team_b_id") and "matches"."toss_decision" in ('bat', 'bowl'))

matches_result_valid.name: matches_result_valid
matches_result_valid.value: ("matches"."completed_at" is null and "matches"."result_type" is null and "matches"."winner_team_id" is null and "matches"."result_summary" is null) or ("matches"."completed_at" is not null and "matches"."scoring_started_at" is not null and "matches"."result_summary" is not null and "matches"."result_type" in ('win', 'tie', 'no_result') and (("matches"."result_type" = 'win' and "matches"."winner_team_id" in ("matches"."team_a_id", "matches"."team_b_id")) or ("matches"."result_type" <> 'win' and "matches"."winner_team_id" is null)))

matches_concluded_valid.name: matches_concluded_valid
matches_concluded_valid.value: "matches"."concluded_at" is null or "matches"."completed_at" is not null

match_players_position_valid.name: match_players_position_valid
match_players_position_valid.value: ("match_players"."squad" = 'playing' and "match_players"."position" between 1 and 11) or ("match_players"."squad" = 'substitute' and "match_players"."position" between 1 and 4)

innings_completed_valid.name: innings_completed_valid
innings_completed_valid.value: ("innings"."status" = 'completed') = ("innings"."completed_at" is not null) and ("innings"."status" = 'completed') = ("innings"."end_reason" is not null)

innings_totals_valid.name: innings_totals_valid
innings_totals_valid.value: "innings"."runs" >= 0 and "innings"."wickets" >= 0 and "innings"."legal_balls" >= 0 and "innings"."version" >= 0 and ("innings"."target" is null or "innings"."target" >= 1)

innings_crease_valid.name: innings_crease_valid
innings_crease_valid.value: "innings"."striker_id" is null or "innings"."non_striker_id" is null or "innings"."striker_id" <> "innings"."non_striker_id"

deliveries_numbers_valid.name: deliveries_numbers_valid
deliveries_numbers_valid.value: "deliveries"."seq" >= 1 and "deliveries"."over_number" >= 0 and "deliveries"."balls_in_over" between 0 and 6 and "deliveries"."runs_off_bat" between 0 and 9 and "deliveries"."wides" between 0 and 10 and "deliveries"."no_balls" in (0, 1) and "deliveries"."byes" between 0 and 9 and "deliveries"."leg_byes" between 0 and 9 and "deliveries"."overthrow_runs" between 0 and 9 and "deliveries"."runs_run" >= 0

deliveries_wicket_valid.name: deliveries_wicket_valid
deliveries_wicket_valid.value: ("deliveries"."wicket_type" is null and "deliveries"."dismissed_player_id" is null and "deliveries"."fielder_id" is null) or ("deliveries"."wicket_type" in ('bowled', 'caught', 'lbw', 'run_out', 'stumped', 'hit_wicket', 'obstructing_field', 'retired_hurt', 'retired_out') and "deliveries"."dismissed_player_id" is not null)

deliveries_retirement_empty.name: deliveries_retirement_empty
deliveries_retirement_empty.value: "deliveries"."kind" = 'ball' or ("deliveries"."runs_off_bat" = 0 and "deliveries"."wides" = 0 and "deliveries"."no_balls" = 0 and "deliveries"."byes" = 0 and "deliveries"."leg_byes" = 0 and "deliveries"."overthrow_runs" = 0 and "deliveries"."runs_run" = 0 and not "deliveries"."is_boundary" and not "deliveries"."is_free_hit")

deliveries_free_hit_valid.name: deliveries_free_hit_valid
deliveries_free_hit_valid.value: not "deliveries"."is_free_hit" or "deliveries"."wicket_type" is null or "deliveries"."wicket_type" in ('run_out', 'obstructing_field')
